$comment: Single source of truth for where QA runs. Read by the Playwright harness (playwright.config.ts via QA_ENV), the CI entrypoint (scripts/qa-env.mjs) and the console's Trigger run. An environment with a null baseUrl is listed but cannot be targeted. 'gates' says which environment each automated trigger uses. 'aliasOf' marks an environment that, for this assignment, points at another environment's surface; reports and the console label it as a demo alias. Replace baseUrl and remove aliasOf when the real URL exists.

environments.label: Dev
environments.notes: Assignment demo alias of the public production surface (no separate dev URL exists). Replace baseUrl and remove aliasOf to point at a real dev.

environments.label: Staging
environments.notes: Assignment demo alias of the public production surface (no separate staging URL exists). Replace baseUrl and remove aliasOf to point at a real staging.

environments.label: Production
environments.notes: Public, pre-auth surface only. Read-only checks with a fail-closed request guard.
